ABOUT PROMPT PLUMBING

Your trusted plumbing partner in Bangalore

Reliable water leakage detection, honest diagnosis, and long-term repairs — for homes and businesses.

We handle everything from a single leaking tap to full bathroom fit-outs: angle valves, wall-mixers, health faucets, concealed diverters, urinals, and dampness on walls caused by hidden pipe leaks. Every job is inspected on site before we quote — no guesswork, no repeat visits.

Trusted by homeowners, apartment communities and commercial spaces across Bangalore for plumbing that's done right the first time.

WHAT WE FIX

Expert plumbing & leak detection

Residential and commercial plumbing services across Bangalore — repairs built to last, not just patched over.

◎

Leak Detection

Advanced technology to trace hidden leaks behind walls and under floors before they cause real damage.

⬡

Pipeline Repair

Professional repair of damaged supply and drain pipelines, with long-lasting protection against future leaks.

▦

Dampness Treatment

Comprehensive treatment for damp walls and ceilings caused by seepage, protecting your property's structure.

⚙

Tap & Valve Repair

Angle valves, wall mixers, health faucets and cartridges — cleaned, replaced or upgraded on the spot.

▢

Bathroom Fitting Installation

Toilets, basins, sensor urinals and complete new bathroom fit-outs, installed and leak-tested.

☎

Emergency Callouts

Sudden leak or overflow? We respond fast across Bangalore, residential or commercial.

HOW A JOB RUNS

Diagnose, then repair

01
